name: UK-US Falklands Garrison 2032
description: The Falklands garrison in 2032, reinforced: the RAF and Army at Mount Pleasant and Stanley, the Royal Navy's Type 45 and Type 26, and a US Air Force detachment with its AWACS and tankers flying in from Ascension. Needs the CurrentHill UK asset pack for Sky Sabre, Stormer, Ajax, Warrior, Challenger 3 and the ships. The AH-64D stands in for the AH-64E, the C-130J-30 for the A400M, the KC-135 MPRS for the Voyager and the FPS-117 for the Mount Byron radar. The squadrons fly under their own flags; the faction uses the joint task force country because it fields both.
